tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taken live for real customer bookings.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across production applications.
Built a full-stack trading platform across three services (marketing site, trading dashboard, and Express API) featuring JWT-based authentication and Joi-based request validation.
Developed DriftGuard, a MERN-stack security control drift detection tool mapping changes to NIST and GDPR compliance controls within a hackathon timeline.
Built StaySphere, a full-stack property rental platform using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Passport.js authentication with session-based login and ownership-based authorization.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to express my interest in the MERN Developer - Intern role at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on production and project experience across the MERN stack, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my Full Stack Developer Internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which went live for real customer bookings. I implemented role-based access control and managed admin workflows to streamline operations. Additionally, my personal projects include Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform built with the MERN stack featuring JWT-based authentication, Joi validation, and services deployed across Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas. I also developed StaySphere using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Passport.js with complete CRUD functionality and secure authorization. These experiences have given me practical proficiency in building scalable backend systems, REST APIs, and responsive frontends using the MERN stack. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my technical background aligns with your internship and full-time conversion opportunities. Thank you for your time and consideration. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed
